Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

taxonAlign 0.1.0

First release.

  • align_taxa(), update_taxa() and create_taxonomic_update_lookup() align raw taxon names to any taxonomic reference, at any rank, and update them to their accepted names, after APCalign’s approach for the Australian Plant Census.
  • load_taxonomic_resources() loads versioned reference lists from taxonAlign’s data releases (the National Species List groups and the Catalogue of Life for Australian animals); data_release_versions(), data_release_datasets() and download_data_release_files() list and fetch them.
  • taxonomic_reference_schema(), check_taxonomic_reference() and prepare_taxonomic_resources() let you use your own reference tables.
  • A name that is nothing more than a genus, family or other higher-rank name stays as written ("Banksia"), where APCalign gives "Banksia sp. [Banksia]": the input didn’t say "sp.". include_bracketed_info = TRUE treats it as though it had ended in "sp.": "Banksia sp. [<identifier>]".

Developed by Elizabeth Wenk, Fonti Kar.
